import json, os, subprocess, sys, bisect, ipaddress
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from check import decode
from audit import decode_image
import solver, randlayout
exec(open('/tmp/biglayout.py').read().split('for clustered')[0])

case, starts, hops, pv = make(False, 0)
costs = (case["costs"]["hit"], case["costs"]["miss"], case["costs"]["decode"])
env = dict(os.environ, FIDX_ENGINE='/workspace/tmp/engine')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '/workspace/submission/main.py'],
                   input=json.dumps({"cases": [case]}).encode(),
                   stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, env=env)
res = decode(p.stdout)["cases"][0]
ver = res["versions"][0]
nd, size = decode_image(ver["image"], starts, hops)
order = sorted(nd.keys())
recs = [{"kind": nd[o]["kind"], "mode": nd[o]["mode"], "cached": nd[o]["cached"],
         "lo": nd[o]["lo"], "span": nd[o]["span"],
         "children": [order.index(c) for c in nd[o]["children"]],
         "offset": o, "pages": nd[o]["pages"]} for o in order]
touch, qpref = solver.traffic(64, [(r, [bisect.bisect_right(starts, a) - 1 for a in addrs])
                                   for r, addrs in pv])
w_model = sum(solver.node_cost(n, touch, qpref, costs) for n in recs)
w_audit, sz = randlayout.evaluate(starts, hops, ver["image"], pv, costs, 12)
print('reported', res["objective"], 'model', w_model, size, 'audit', w_audit, sz)
print('nodes', [(n['kind'], n['mode'], n['cached'], n['lo'], n['span'], n['pages']) for n in recs])
print('touch[0][64]', touch[0][64], 'q', qpref[64])
for n in recs:
    print('  node', n['kind'], n['mode'], n['cached'], n['lo'], n['span'], n['pages'],
          'T', touch[n['lo']][n['lo']+n['span']], 'Q', qpref[n['lo']+n['span']]-qpref[n['lo']],
          'cost', solver.node_cost(n, touch, qpref, costs))
EOF
